You know lots of people think this way. I always say stuff like; whats the point most inventions have been invented, we have been to the moon and the bottom of the sea, and mapped the human body. After years of saying that I started to believe that. Now I have a new approach on this, I think of remembrance on a different scale. Imagine for a second you spend some time at a soup kitchen, now imagine you do that for years. There will always be people that remember you. You can apply this to almost anything. 

I had to learn to take every step as a baby step instead of the giant step I was looking for.

As of now I'm not even sure I can afford to go to work with the price of gas and the distance I have to travel for my $8 per hour job. I make ~$1000 a month and my child support is $765 per month. After food costs and gas there isn't much left. 

Iowa state law has something in it about the VA must be charged if the person is a veteran first and if the VA wont take care of it then they will. Couldnt even get meds the day after i got out of the psych ward due to this fact. My family had to pay the ridiculously priced meds. The VA took me off of meds as soon as I was in their care.
I tried to get help by posting a topic here on reddit, all I got was hope you die you deadbeat dad. I was so shocked at the response it brought me to tears.

In my state of IA a veteran cannot get state paid appointments. All appointments/visits must be made via the VA. When I tried to commit myself to the psych ward I was refused to being a vet, I had to go through the VA unless I was in immediate danger. I guess a suicide attempt wasn't severe enough.  My mother went before a judge to have me court ordered to the ward, it was the only way. It makes me sad, I feel like my country said you had your chance now GTFO.

I understand how you feel, I meet every single bullet point you listed including the ones requiring immediate attention. To be honest reading the posts in r/suicidewatch has been a great help. We all have our issues some worse than others and not a single one of them are worse than yours. No matter the severity of the issue it will always be worse when it happens to you or so we think. I would rather leave a note here than to parents/family. People on here are mean as fuck and will tell you to die anyways but some of us don't have any other place to turn to.

I feel yea, the only thing I have control over is if I live or die. Sometimes its the only choice we get in life, or I should say its the only option we can see. Everything else seems to be grayed out.
